content: Yɛsu anà mpää a ndwà a Nzam
Yàmɛnà naa Yɛsu kàtoo nde u ndwà a Nzam anà kàkäl nde mukyà, alɔŋki ande bàyàsin apà nde ntɔn mukun'swaŋ ntööŋ a ndwà a Nzam.
Nde waa kàfuur naa: « Nkye bɛ làkimanà indiir abi byanswà? Ndandaa mɛ alàkyään, akà nkɔŋ mwɛy ifàsàsal anki udu a nkɔŋ yumwɛy. Ya yanswà ikyer asàpää. »
Ngyɛb aŋàdiir anà nkwaaŋ
Yɛsu kàkäl wàŋàbwaay udu a mɔŋ a in'te a ɔlive, alɔŋki bàsin apà nde, waa bàtɛn a nde naa: « Ikyään taaŋ isàyà ndaa ayi, idiim nà isàswaŋ ngyeel angye anà ntsüü a mɛɛn. »
Yɛsu kafuur naa: « Làkäl kà igyɛɛŋ, wɛy mbuur ukɔɔn alakur.
Ntɔn baar mbɔɔn bàsàyà kà ikɔb amɛ, waa bàsàtɛn naa: "Mɛ in'wà Klistɔ!" Ba bàsàkur baar mbɔɔn.
Bɛ làsàwem naa bye anà ità anà in'bää a ità. Twon lan'tɛɛr: indiir abi ikyer ayà, wɛɛ bya kà ntsüü anki.
Un'sɛŋ mwɛy asànwaan anà un'sɛŋ wumwɛy, imwol mwɛy anà imwol kyumwɛy, kà itiir a nsi imwɛy imwɛy, ngyal ikyer asàkal anà mɛɛn ikyer asàtɛɛr.
Wɛɛ indiir abi byanswà byàsàkal nsɛmà a usaay.
Apan, bàsàlasà u ngyɛb aŋàdiir, waa bàsàladwa. In'sɛŋ myanswà ikyer asàlayiiŋ ntɔn ikɔb amɛ.
Apan, bàmbɔɔn bàsàpiy làkwikilà aba, ba bàsàmɛɛn nku ba a ba, anà bàsàyiiŋ ba a ba.
Aŋangɔɔm a loor mbɔɔn bàkyer asàmbarà, waa bàsàbwiy baar mbɔɔn.
Ukwen a baar mbɔɔn bàsàbwà mpye, ntɔn ube bàkyer asàsöönà.
Wɛɛ mbuur asàsà muküünà tii u ntsüü, asàwà mɔ̈ɔ̈.
Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ là Imwol alà bàkyer asàkyään la u mɛɛn manswà. Kya isàkal imbäl ntɔn in'sɛŋ myanswà. Apan waa ntsüü isàyà. »
Bɔɔmà a kölàköl
« Lalan, mpal làsàman bɛ lingyoomà mbɔɔn alà kàtɛn ŋangɔɔm Danyel lan'bilà kà ikal a in'kyɛɛl, - wɛy mbuur akataŋà uyöb! -
Apan, wɛy baar bàsàkal u Yuday, bàtiin uboo a myɔŋ,
wɛy mbuur asàkal udu a nsyä a ndwà, ukɔɔn ayàtɔlà ntɔn muwal indiir abyà uboo a ndwà ande,
wɛy mbuur awà u ywaŋ ande, ukɔɔn afurà ndwà ntɔn mukàwal ipfɛy ande.
Ngyɛb akà akaar aŋayöm anà akaar bàsàkal munüü baan kà ilä abin!
Làyamà ntɔn bɛ làkɔɔn asàtiin u paŋà a làbe, itàkal kà ilä a saba!
Ntɔn, umpal ayin, isàkal anà ngyɛb aŋàdiir mpa aŋàtàkal fà nsɛmà a mɛɛn tii ŋàbà, anà ya sye ifàsàkal anki akà ikikye.
Yàlàkal naa Nzam ukɔ̈ɔ̈n atyey ilä abin, akà mbuur mwɛy kàlàwà anki mɔ̈ɔ̈. Wɛɛ, ntɔn baar kàsɔ̈ɔ̈l nde, ilä abin isàkal byàŋàtyeey.
Apan, isàkal naa mbuur mwɛy kan'tɛn a bɛ naa: "Làler, Klistɔ awà kà!" Itàkal naa: "Nde awunà kunà!", twon lun'kyey.
Ntɔn aklistɔ a loor anà aŋangɔɔm a loor bàkyer asàmbarà, bàsàkyer idiim a kölàköl anà impà ntɔn mukur baar, kya ipöl isàkal, itàkal baar bàŋàsɔɔl.
Làler, mɛ ya amàlaweey kusà. »
« Abun, isàkal naa bàmàlakyään naa: "Làler, nde wà u nsye a ipɔl!", twon lan'kyà. "Nde wà kà ikal a mpey", twon lan'kyey.
Ntɔn, ngyeel a Mwan a mbuur isàkal asànaa muŋyä ufàpàrà wa fà mper làfàsɛnà taaŋ tii mper làfàkàminà la.
Ntsü yanswà iwà ndom, nɛn ayifàdyà in'twaŋ ifàkàköŋ kwo. »
Ngyeel a Mwan a mbuur
« Taaŋ a mbɔɔn tɛy ungö a mpay a kölàköl yà ilä abin, taaŋ làsàbwà làpib, nsöŋ ifàsàpà anki kyɛɛy a wa, mbwaar ikyer asàbwà fà du, ngwal a du ikyer asàni.
Apan, idiim a Mwan a mbuur isàmɛnà u du, apan in'sɛŋ myanswà amyà u mɛɛn ikyer asàlaal, mya isàman Mwan a mbuur wàmuyà uboo a itööm a du anà unkaak a ngwal anà làkoo.
Nde asàtɔm akyeey ande anà mfuŋ a kölàköl, waa ba bàsàtüüb baar kàsɔ̈ɔ̈l nde u mper yànà, fà nswɛŋ a du tii nswɛŋ yumwɛy. »
An'lɔɔŋ man'fà unsà un'te a fige
« Làyöb an'lɔɔŋ man'fà unsà un'te a fige: isàkal naa an'kɔkà ande man'bulà an'dà an'dà anà nkay sye yan'too, làyöb apan naa paŋà aŋàbwaŋ là tsütsü.
Abun, akà bɛ sye, mpal làsàman bɛ indiir abi byanswà, làyöb naa Mwan a Mbuur wà tsütsü a minambwo a ndwà abɛ.
Ndandaa mɛ alàkyään, nkööl ayi isàkal aŋàlyaŋ anki kusà a ndaa ayi muyà.
Du anà mɛɛn màkyer asàlyaŋ, wɛɛ ndaa amɛ isàlyaŋ anki akà ikikye. »
Nzam mpɛl ayöb ntsüü a taaŋ
« Wɛɛ akà mbuur mwɛy uyöb anki ilä kya anà taaŋ la, itàkal akyeey, itàkal Mwan, nà Taa mpɛl.
Asànaa ndaa yàlyaŋ utaaŋ a Nɔwà, ngyeel a Mwan a mbuur isàkal abun sye.
Ntɔn, u paŋà alan, kusà ikül a mbul muyööl mɛɛn, baar bàkäl mudyà, munwà, mutà an'bɔr anà mupà baan aba an'bɔr tii ilä kàbilà Nɔwà kà an'swà.
Ba bàmɛnà anki akà ube mwɛy tii ilä màyöl an'dà anà masyen ma ba banswà. Ya isàkal sye abun umpal usàyà Mwan a mbuur.
Apan, abaal bɔ̈ɔ̈l bàsàkal kan'ywaŋ: umwɛy bàkyer asun'syen, wumwɛy bàkyer asun'wɛy.
Akaar bɔ̈ɔ̈l bàsàkal muyir: umwɛy bàkyer asun'syɛn, wumwɛy bàkyer asun'wɛy.
Abun, làkäl kà igyɛɛŋ, ntɔn bɛ làyöb anki ilä usàyà Mwol abɛ.
Bɛ làkyàyöb: yàlàkal naa ŋandwà akiyöbà naa taaŋ nà mbüüb usàyà u mpib, nde kàlikalà kà igyɛɛŋ anà nde kàlun'wɛyà anki mubilà u ndwà ande.
Undiir awun, bɛ sye làkäl aŋàlɔ̈ɔ̈n, ntɔn Mwan a mbuur asàyà u taaŋ mpa làsàyöb bɛ. »
Un'syääl a lää anà un'syääl mpa awà lää
« Abun, nà awà un'syääl a lää anà wàŋàlɔ̈ɔ̈n awà kàpɛ nkum buur a asyääl a ndwà ande ntɔn mukapà isa u taaŋ a taaŋ?
Un'sak akà un'syääl awà usyetaan nkum ande, taaŋ usàyà nde, wàmukyer abà!
Ndandaa mɛ alàkyään, nde asun'pà buur a indiir ande byanswà.
Wɛɛ, isàkal naa nde wà un'syääl un'be, nde asàyweer naa: "Nkum amɛ usyefurà anki agyägyä",
anà nde ubulà mudüb atɔŋ ande bà isal, mudyà anà munwà ikal imwɛy a in'yöör a man,
nkum a un'syääl awà asàyà kà ilä anà u taaŋ mpa uyöb nde.
Nde akyer asun'böŋ anà asun'pà ntaaŋàmbar ikwe a baar a mpem yweel: kwo isàkal ilel anà nkwoor a an'din. »
